facts.text: The hotel sits along Harry Thuku Road in Nairobi, about 10 minutes from the airport.
facts.excerpt: nestled along Harry Thuku Road, just 10 minutes from the airport

facts.text: Some suites are called 1937 Rooms and are presented as a tribute to the hotel's past.
facts.excerpt: Staying in a 1937 Room means immersing yourself in the rich history of Fairmont the Norfolk. These rooms are a tribute to the elegance and grandeur of the past

facts.text: Deluxe Courtyard Rooms have views of the garden, with exotic birds, flowers and the hotel's vintage transportation collection.
facts.excerpt: Each of our deluxe courtyard rooms feature a marvelous view of the iconic garden welcoming a variety of exotic birds, flowers and our iconic vintage transportation collection.

facts.text: Deluxe Verandah Rooms each have a private verandah with part views of the gardens.
facts.excerpt: Each room features a private verandah with part views of tranquil gardens.

facts.text: The Fairmont Family Room has two interconnecting spaces, with a queen bed, two single beds and a rain shower.
facts.excerpt: The Fairmont Family Room offers boutique luxury with two interconnecting spaces, featuring a queen bed and two Single Beds along with a rain shower.

facts.text: The hotel offers a Fairmont Gold experience.
facts.excerpt: including the elevated Fairmont Gold experience

facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by tropical gardens.
The hotel serves a Signature Afternoon High Tea with Gourmet, Iconic or vegetarian menus, each made for two to share.
facts.excerpt: Gather your closest friends for an unforgettable experience with our Signature Afternoon High Tea. Select from our Gourmet, Iconic or Vegeterian menus, each thoughtfully crafted for two to share

facts.text: The hotel has a spa and a gym.
facts.excerpt: Our historic hotel offers a serene spa, state-of-the-art gym, in-house culinary and golf experiences

facts.text: The hotel offers guided city tours of Nairobi's history.
facts.excerpt: Nairobi’s rich history with guided city tours.

facts.text: The hotel has venues for meetings and conferences.
facts.excerpt: Host your next event at Fairmont The Norfolk, where historic charm meets modern sophistication. With versatile venues

facts.text: The hotel calls itself Kenya's most historic hotel.
facts.excerpt: Book your Nairobi getaway at Kenya’s most historic hotel.
